body:
This task's scope:
Root store, the one-time move, and readers switched over: board::task(s), scope::tasks_in and scope::home, outside.rs, view.rs, migrate.rs, and tests/fake_agent.py:12. Also check lockdown refuses <root>/.solace/tasks/ with E6006.

The broader goal, not all in scope for this task:
Goal: a task server (Rust module solace-cli/src/tasks.rs, inside solace serve) is the only writer of one root task store at <root>/.solace/tasks/. The board, and later the archive and Strategy pages, are clients of its /tasks/... API. Clients must not depend on how it's built, so it could move to Gleam/BEAM later.

Already done (this task): DECISIONS.md D-77 (not D-76, which was taken) and the Spec 15 updates (storage, computed changes, the request key on POST /tasks, /events ids). No Rust exists yet. The subtasks implement D-77. Tell each one to read D-77 and Spec 15 first, and to cite D-17, D-18 and D-61 point 4 as amended.

Decisions every subtask must respect
One root store. Tasks have no home project and never move. The task keeps a home field meaning only the project its agent works from. Run logs, conversations, review checkpoints, before-files and images stay in <project>/.solace/board/<tid>/.
Single writer. The task server applies operations one at a time, in order, writing each file atomically (write, then rename). Review should find no save( outside tasks.rs.
Agents send messages, not writes. task note, task done, ask, verification and settings proposals go to <root>/.solace/tasks/inbox/<id>.json (write, fsync, rename). They are acknowledged only after that. The server applies them in order, and again on startup. With no server running, they wait for serve.
Changes and undo live only in each project's store.db, committed with the code change and keyed by task id.
board_touches gains run and name columns.
The task JSON drops changes, which is now computed from the stores.
Undo goes by task id alone.
Atomic undo.
Symbols: Store::transaction uses SAVEPOINT so it nests, and main.rs wraps the command and its undo rows in one outer savepoint.
Files: a write-ahead undo record in .solace/pending/ holds the task, run, path and before-bytes. A declared run writes one record with its whole snapshot. Recovery at the start of each command and at serve start either adds the rows (the file changed) or drops the record (it didn't).
Check whether materialize writes .gleam files before the commit.
WAL. Store::at sets journal_mode=WAL and a busy_timeout, so changes can be read without the lock.
Locks.
Task-only actions take no project lock: create, edit, move, note, stop, cancel without undo, scope, and answers.
agent_guard reads run state from the task file, with no lock, for task … commands.
Code-changing actions keep the store lock of each project they touch: undo, moving into a final column, approving settings, accepting outside changes, and adding or removing a project.
Idempotent create. The board sends a request id once per submit and disables the button while waiting. The server stores it on the task and returns the existing task for a repeat.
One-time move on serve. Under the serve lock, before projects are claimed, move every <project>/.solace/board/*.json into the root store. Set home to the source project, fail loudly on a duplicate id, and move each task's changes into board_touches in the project each change names.

Suggested order
Root store, the one-time move, and readers switched over: board::task(s), scope::tasks_in and scope::home, outside.rs, view.rs, migrate.rs, and tests/fake_agent.py:12. Also check lockdown refuses <root>/.solace/tasks/ with E6006.
tasks.rs writer thread, /tasks/... routes, the inbox and agent messages, and idempotent create. Move the board routes onto it.
Undo atomicity and WAL, with the SOLACE_FAIL_AFTER=command crash hook.
Lock changes, including agent_guard.
Done-when tests (assign each to the subtask that makes it possible)
Create, note and stop succeed in under about 1 s while a declared sleep 5 command runs.
A double create (in sequence and in parallel) with the same request makes one task.
A message left in inbox/ is applied after serve restarts.
Tasks from two projects keep their scopes, conversations and changes after the move, and undo works on them.
A crash between a code change and its undo record leaves neither, or both.
tests/board_acceptance.py and tests/workspace_acceptance.py pass through rust-acceptance (D-71).
Update the unit test agent_guard_follows_the_run, and add one for a revert with a pending changes message.
Risks to flag
The /events id format changes, so the board's reconnect (Last-Event-ID) needs a test.
A CLI run with no server leaves its notes waiting until the next serve.
This touches many writers across board.rs, so each subtask should keep the existing acceptance suites passing.
